decisions.reason: Address autocomplete builds directly on the firm's postal and address master data used for grid-area mapping, so it fits existing know-how and costs little to maintain.

The Austrian gas grid fee database carries the firm's core grid-fee data expertise into a neighbouring regulatory market; it is somewhat less familiar but still learnable through its existing data processes.
Determining peak load windows rests on the firm's deep knowledge of German grid regulation and fee data, giving it strong capacity to interpret results and refine the service.
An end-customer tariff database lies at the heart of an energy market data provider's competence and complements its grid fee products.
Custom web services draw on the firm's existing programming and data delivery capabilities and serve as a flexible channel for client-specific work.
Postal code lookup draws on the same reference data that underpins the firm's other services, so it is cheap to keep and closely related to existing knowledge.
